item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello there! Let's get started. Happy weekend! A whole day to play. Here is your weather report for Saturday, September 26. It's Saturday, a whole day to do what you like. Looking outside in Shanghai, today will be rumbling with thunderstorms. The warmest part of the day will be 33 degrees, and the coolest 25. It's going to be a real scorcher. The chance of rain is 36 percent. The sun goes down at 5:46 this evening, about 2 minutes earlier than yesterday. Can you feel the days getting shorter? It's a hot one. A sun hat and a water bottle are a good idea! As for tomorrow, expect it to be rumbling with thunderstorms, with a high of 29 degrees. A question for you: what are you looking forward to? And that's it for today's weather. Have a lovely time!
